name: scope: a root folder that is no place of code is not opened

name: scope: the typed lint gets it through the kit's block

name: scope: only folders are named, never a file at the root
test: pnpm vitest run kit/lint-scope.test.mts -t "are every one that holds no package"

name: scope: a hidden root folder is left out like any other
test: pnpm vitest run kit/lint-scope.test.mts -t "are every one that holds no package"

name: scope: without declared layers nothing is left out

name: scope: a root that is not there is no error

name: scope: git is not asked (the design this replaces: what git ignores is left out)

name: scope: tools/ is code
test: pnpm vitest run kit/lint-scope.test.mts -t "is the packages, tools/, the named folders and the files at the root"

name: scope: a folder the project names is code

name: scope: a workspace package nothing declares is still linted

name: scope: a named folder is told by its first part
find: const firstPart = (path: string): string => path.split("/")[0] as string;
test: pnpm vitest run kit/lint-scope.test.mts -t "do not include the folder of a package that is declared somewhere else"

name: outside: a package that imports a file in no package is a finding

name: outside: a dependency that is not installed is not such an import
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/gates.test.mts -t "does not call an import of another package"

name: outside: a Node built-in is not such an import
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/gates.test.mts -t "does not call an import of another package"

test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/lint-scope-covers-gates.test.mts -t "fails the structure gate when it is visible"

name: root: a dot-folder is passed over

name: root: an installed or built folder is no finding

name: root: a folder named under codeFolders is declared

test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/lint-scope-covers-gates.test.mts -t "is no finding once it is named under codeFolders"
